mapper.select: SELECT sd.id, sd.dept_code, sd.dept_name FROM sys_user_department sud INNER JOIN sys_department sd ON sud.department_id = sd.id AND sd.deleted = 0 WHERE sud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sud.is_primary DESC

SELECT sd.id, sd.dept_code, sd.dept_name FROM sys_user_department sud INNER JOIN sys_department sd ON sud.department_id = sd.id AND sd.deleted = 0 WHERE sud.user_id = #{userId} AND sud.is_primary = 1 LIMIT 1
